lead: Rajendra Prasad was a lawyer, born on 3 December 1884 in Ziradei Block.
He died on 28 February 1963 in Patna at the age of 78.
He has 6 credited works on public record and has held the office of President of India and Member of the Constituent Assembly of India.

sections.heading: Rajendra Prasad — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Rajendra Prasad was born on 3 December 1884 in Ziradei Block, and holds citizenship of British Raj, India and Dominion of India.
His listed education includes University of Calcutta, Surendranath College, Presidency University and Surendranath Law College.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi and English.

sections.heading: Rajendra Prasad — Career and Professional Work
paras: Rajendra Prasad works primarily as a lawyer, politician, teacher, scholar and writer, with University of Calcutta listed among his employers.
He has held the following offices: President of India (1950–1962), Member of the Constituent Assembly of India (1946–1950) and chairperson (1946–1950). He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
